changelog:
wesley-dashboard-builder 1.0.0 – Initial release with full web dashboard generation and deployment workflow.

- Creates live dashboards, full websites, and social proof pages for Wesley-Agent, with mobile-first, multi-screen HTML/CSS/JS output.
- Integrates real-time API data and optional Telegram bot uploads for photo galleries.
- Produces self-contained files (all inline, no local dependencies) ready for instant VPS deployment via Cloudflare tunnel.
- Outlines standard project structure, screen types, and design/coding rules (dark theme, fallback data, navigation).
- Step-by-step instructions provided for dashboard creation, API integration, media usage, and deployment.
- Includes detailed checklists to ensure quality and functionality before delivery.
